To form the feminine, the affix 'ṅīṣ' (ī) is appended because (īśvara) is included in the gaurādi class via Aṣṭādhyāyī 4.1.41 (ṣidgaurādibhyaśca), yielding strictly (īśvarī). Consequently, the Ṣaṣṭhī Tatpuruṣa compound denoting "the Lady of the Kula" MUST resolve exclusively to (kuleśvarī). The form (kuleśvarā) with the feminine affix 'ṭāp' (ā) is a morphological impossibility for this Tatpuruṣa resolution and represents a typographical corruption in the Apte 1957 edition.
